name: Agrovision Corp. (renamed Fruitist in 2025)
note: Founder-led, investor-backed berry company headquartered in Los Angeles; its premium berries are sold under The Fruitist brand. A March 2024 growth capital investment was led by Aliment Capital (company release); Blue Book Services (Apr 2025) reports the Dalio Family Office joined as a backer alongside Aliment Capital. No individual or fund is named with a controlling stake.
